summary: Compact optical distance sensor in a black rectangular plastic housing. Two square lens towers (emitter and receiver) sit side by side along the long axis. A flat mounting flange with a round-ended tab at each end carries a through hole. A small connector sits on the side of the board, with the PCB visible on the back.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat back face of the housing and mounting tabs, which seats against a panel or bracket. The two tab holes pass through it along the lens axis.

notes: No printed dimensions appear in the images. The bounding box uses the listed size (44.5 × 18.9 × 21.6 mm), which is flagged as unverified. I assigned the axes myself: x is the long axis through the mounting tabs, z is the lens direction, and y is the remaining dimension. The hole diameter (about 3 mm), hole spacing (about 38 mm) and hole z position are rough estimates from image proportions, not stated values. The back face offset assumes the box is centered on the part. The connector and PCB details are not modeled.
